finding: check_target now answers INSIDE for a short-name path that is a dangling link; the previous code and target_for refuse it with R-06
why: realpath(base) turns a dangling link into its missing target, so R-06's lexists() sees nothing and passes. The target is realpath'd the same way and lands below it. The unresolved link at <root>/<short name> never reaches the rule.
fix: Run R-06 on the unresolved path (or refuse when lexists(unresolved) and not isdir(unresolved)), and resolve only for display and the _below comparison; add a dangling-link test.

finding: `ask.folder or os.path.join(ask.root, ask.entry.short_name)` fallback is dead code
why: The only construction site of a short-name _Ask always passes a non-None base, because the unrooted case returns earlier. The fallback branch can never run.
fix: Use ask.folder directly and drop the fallback, or keep it and add a test that reaches it.
